name: Delivery Receipts
comments: 2026-08-17: the age gate moved from a condition (age_days_gt: 1) into action
brackets so a 30-day purge could be added too. Day of receipt stays in INBOX
(deliberate no-op bracket) so it's visible; files into Delivery Receipts from
day 1; purges to Deleted Messages from day 30. Net day-0/day-1 behavior is
unchanged from before -- only the 30-day purge is new. See README's
2026-08-19: priority moved from 40 to 110. This is a sender-agnostic subject
match ('Delivered:' prefix) so at 40 it ran BEFORE brand-specific sender rules
(Amazon, Nextdoor, DPD/Evri/Royal Mail/Yodel/FedEx/UPS, all priority 100) and was
notifications were being trapped here instead of reaching
Receipts/Retail/Amazon. 110 matches the existing 'catch-all mop-up' tier
(other brand catch-alls also sit at 110) so specific sender rules get first
refusal, and this rule only catches couriers/senders with no dedicated rule.
